description:
# Check: upstream input.test.ts

## Upstream file
tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/input.test.ts

## Subject
Single-line text input component with kill ring and undo/redo (subset of editor behaviors).

## Upstream test count (approx)
60

## Behaviors asserted upstream
- submits value including backslash on Enter
- inserts backslash as regular character
- no overflow with wide CJK/fullwidth text at cursor start/middle/end position
- keeps cursor visible when horizontally scrolling wide text
- Ctrl+W saves deleted text to kill ring and Ctrl+Y yanks it
- Ctrl+U saves deleted text to kill ring
- Ctrl+K saves deleted text to kill ring
- Ctrl+Y no-op when kill ring is empty
- Alt+Y cycles through kill ring after Ctrl+Y
- Alt+Y no-op if not preceded by yank
- Alt+Y no-op if kill ring has one entry
- consecutive Ctrl+W accumulates into one kill ring entry
- non-delete actions break kill accumulation
- non-yank actions break Alt+Y chain
- kill ring rotation persists after cycling
- backward deletions prepend, forward deletions append during accumulation
- Alt+D deletes word forward and saves to kill ring
- handles yank in middle of text
- handles yank-pop in middle of text
- undo no-op when stack empty
- coalesces consecutive word characters into one undo unit
- undoes spaces one at a time
- undoes backspace
- undoes forward delete
- undoes Ctrl+W (delete word backward)
- undoes Ctrl+K (delete to line end)
- undoes Ctrl+U (delete to line start)
- undoes yank
- undoes paste atomically
- undoes Alt+D (delete word forward)
- cursor movement starts new undo unit

## Upstream dependencies
Input from ../src/components/input.js; visibleWidth

## Upstream notes
Single-line variant of Editor. Kill ring and undo tests are comprehensive. Wide character handling critical for rendering.

## Candidate Elixir counterpart(s)
- apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/components/input_test.exs

## Processing protocol
Same as standard check ticket protocol in epic opi-q5k description. Compliance ticket must list each missing behavior and require a post-implementation re-comparison. Block opi-q5k.1.
